texto: In 2024, Tocando em Frente won the LED Award — Light in Education (Prêmio LED — Luz na Educação), promoted by Globo and the Roberto Marinho Foundation, in the Students category. The initiative was recognized among more than 3,000 projects entered in the award's third edition.

titulo: Watson Institute & Western Union Foundation Fellowship Summit
texto: Bianca Gajardoni, co-founder of Tocando em Frente, was invited to present the organization's work and impact at the summit, expanding recognition of the initiative to strengthen education in Brazilian public schools.

Luiza Vilanova and Bianca Gajardoni took part in "The Wall" — the wall challenge on the TV Globo show Domingão com Huck, aired on June 30, 2024. Representing Tocando em Frente, the pair faced the giant wall of questions and answers, playing for a cash prize for the initiative.
